messages:
Marta (Support): Escalating Veridian trial — SSO completes but embed ingest returns 403. Renewal convo in 8 days, customer is on a demo next week. Marking P0. :rotating_light:
Nina (CS): Ack. Paste repro + any logs and owner contact. I'll prep a comms plan and keep renewal status updated.
Marta (Support): Repro (prod + staging):
```
GET /auth/okta/callback 302 -> /app
POST /embed/ingest 403 {\"error\":\"forbidden\", \"detail\":\"tenant_unmapped\"}
```
Marta (Support): Account: veridian-trial, region=us-west-2, SSO=Okta. Tried cache clear and key rotate, no change. Owner: @carmen.veridian, PST. I scheduled placeholder sync at 11:00 PST.
Leo (Eng): Looking. I see a tenant-router config change pushed ~30m ago. Pulling mapping logs now. :mag_right:
Asha (Solutions): Comms suggestion: 1) immediate ack + 20m ETA for root cause; 2) include manual mapping workaround in the note; 3) offer 30m enablement + short feedback form to capture renewal signal; 4) mark renewal as "watch" until CS session. I'll draft message copy and KB link.
Nina (CS): Good. Marta  can you confirm owner prefers email or phone for the sync?
Marta (Support): Carmen prefers email. Sent quick ack and ETA. Customer replied they'd like the workaround in case they need it during the demo. :thumbsup:
triage-bot: deploy-start tenant-router-hotfix 3311223400
Leo (Eng): Found regression: router drops tenant when name contains underscore. Hotfix built, running tests (~12m).
triage-bot: deploy-succeeded tenant-router-hotfix 3311223465
Leo (Eng): Post-deploy: smoke tests pass for veridian-trial; embed ingest returns 200 and auth+embed flow completes.
Nina (CS): I'll confirm with @carmen.veridian and propose enablement to walk through flow and capture feedback. Temporarily clearing "at-risk" after session outcome.
Marta (Support): Closing support ticket and routing follow-ups to CS: enablement invite, post-call summary, renewal review.
Asha (Solutions): I'll send the invite with timeline, manual map KB: https://redwood.internal/kb/tenant-router#manual-map, and a 3-question feedback link.
Nina (CS): Assigning follow-ups: 1) Enablement owner: Asha; 2) Customer-facing summary + postmortem: Leo + Marta; 3) Renewal check in 7 days: Nina. Updating CRM and adding notes. :white_check_mark:
